import sys
from datetime import datetime, timedelta


def minutes(time_str):
    h, m = map(int, time_str.split(":"))
    return h * 60 + m


def hm(total_minutes):
    hours = total_minutes // 60
    minutes = total_minutes % 60
    return f"{hours}:{minutes:02d}"


def iso_week(year, month, day):
    date = datetime(year, month, day)
    # ISO week starts on Monday
    jan1 = datetime(date.year, 1, 1)
    delta = (date - jan1).days
    # Find first Thursday
    thursday = jan1 + timedelta(days=delta - (jan1.weekday() + 1) % 7)
    # Week number starts with the week containing this Thursday
    return thursday.isocalendar()[1]


def parse_shift(line):
    parts = line.split()
    name = parts[0]
    date_str = parts[1]
    start_str = parts[2]
    end_str = parts[3]
    year, month, day = map(int, date_str.split("-"))
    week = iso_week(year, month, day)
    start_min = minutes(start_str)
    end_min = minutes(end_str)
    # Shift crosses midnight: end is earlier than start
    if end_min < start_min:
        end_min += 1440  # 24*60
    return (name, week, end_min - start_min)


def main():
    target = {}
    weeks = {}
    for line in sys.stdin:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        parts = line.split()
        if parts[0] == "target":
            name = parts[1]
            target_time = parts[2]
            target[name] = minutes(target_time)
        else:
            shift = parse_shift(line)
            name, week, duration = shift
            weeks[(name, week)] = weeks.get((name, week), 0) + duration
    # Sort employees alphabetically
    employee_names = sorted(target.keys())
    for name in employee_names:
        if name not in target:
            continue
        total_overtime = timedelta(0)
        for (emp, week), worked in sorted(weeks.items()):
            if emp == name:
                target_min = target[name]
                diff = worked - target_min
                sign = "+" if diff >= 0 else "-"
                print(
                    f"{name} {week} {hm(worked)} {sign}{hm(abs(diff))}"
                )
                total_overtime += timedelta(minutes=abs(diff))
        if total_overtime > timedelta(0):
            print(f"{name} overtime {hm(total_overtime.total_seconds() // 60)}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
